title: Bitcoin mining difficulty reaches new all-time high as hash
content: TL;DR: The Bitcoin network continues its unwavering operation with a robust hashrate of 948.74 EH/s, securing block 935,456. While the next difficulty adjustment is early in its cycle (1.6% complete), the consistent computational power underscores Bitcoin's foundational security against a backdrop of global economic uncertainty. Transactors should note the stable network conditions, reinforcing Bitcoin's role as the hardest, most reliable monetary asset in a world of debasing fiat.
author: Al Ingle
